This is a mid-to-senior Backend Developer role at Aretum, requiring around five years of experience, focused on supporting and enhancing an existing client-facing web application rather than greenfield development. The work covers ongoing maintenance, integrations, accessibility, and performance optimization within a sprint-based Agile cycle. The core stack is Python (with frameworks like Django) on AWS, a TypeScript front-end, RESTful APIs, relational and non-relational databases, and scalable search technology for handling large data sets.
